violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. -Cutting board on prep lines needs repair, Deep cuts, Discolored
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Need to clean cabinet under dipper well.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - Single use items found on floor in back storage area. Corrected on site.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. - Paper towels empty at dispenser in food truck and on ordering line. Corrected on site.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Trailer: ensure sanitizing solution used for wet wiping cloths available.
General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Building: cover used on wire storage shelves must be a cleanable and non-absorbent material. (currently a pink cloth)

Prep/vegetable sink. — --Plumbing fixtures are not plumbed with a physical air gap on the drain line. - espresso machine, dipper well. Handwash sink, dishwasher, ice bin, ice maker and Coke machine drain lines extend below the grate cover on the floor drains.
